Bulbous_Periscopic_Eyes.description: Classic frog eyes sitting extremely high atop the skull. This allows the mostly submerged entity to perfectly survey the shoreline for terrestrial prey while remaining 95% hidden beneath the murky water.

Horizontal_Slit_Pupils.description: Rectangular, horizontally oriented pupils characteristic of ground-dwelling toads. They provide a spectacularly wide panoramic field of view to scan the horizon for creeping predators.

Vertical_Slit_Pupils.description: Cat-like vertical slits evolved for precise ambush hunting in low-light jungles. They allow for incredibly sharp depth perception, calculating the exact distance required to strike a moth mid-air.

Heart_Shaped_Pupils.description: Uniquely shaped pupils that organically filter out the intensely blinding glare characteristic of shallow, sun-dappled streams. They ensure perfect vision when looking up toward the surface.

Nictitating_Membrane_Goggles.description: A heavily thickened, perfectly transparent third eyelid. When the entity dives, this film sweeps sideways across the eye, acting as built-in biological swimming goggles to eliminate underwater blur and protect the cornea.

Reduced_Subterranean_Ocelli.description: Vestigial, tiny eyes completely covered by a layer of translucent skin. They cannot form images, only vaguely sensing the stark difference between absolute subterranean dark and surface daylight.

Retractable_Ocular_Bulbs.description: Eyes lacking a bony floor beneath the socket. When swallowing an impossibly large meal, the entity intentionally yanks its eyes violently down into the roof of its mouth to physically help shove the struggling prey down its throat.

Tapetum_Lucidum_Amphibiorum.description: A highly specialized mirrored layer behind the retina identical to a cat's. At night, encountering the entity reveals two glowing, terrifyingly bright orbs floating seamlessly in the dark swamp foliage.

Parietal_Third_Eye.description: A primitive, distinct photoreceptive organ situated squarely on the top of the head between the main eyes. It specifically watches the sky for the sudden, dark shadow of a stooping hawk, triggering an instant evasive reflex.

Bifocal_Aquatic_Lenses.description: The eye is literally split perfectly in half horizontally. The upper half is adapted for precisely focusing in the air, while the lower half is shaped perfectly for water. The entity floats at the exact waterline, watching dual overlapping realities.
